blocks.text: Central Port Coquitlam home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

152 condos sold in Central Port Coquitlam with a median price of $572,500 (the middle half sold between $473,750 and $635,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $627 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $439 a month. 24 townhomes sold in Central Port Coquitlam with a median price of $999,950 (the middle half sold between $757,500 and $1,054,900), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 100.0% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $611 per square foot, a median year built of 2024 and a median strata fee of $389 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Central Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses and 139 condos and townhomes listed in Central Port Coquitlam. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Central Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes had 14% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Central Port Coquitlam from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses and 96 condos and townhomes sold in Central Port Coquitlam over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in July with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 29 sold.

faq.q: How big is Central Port Coquitlam compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Central Port Coquitlam held 13.1% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 63.5% of the 219 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Central Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 11.5% of the 157 homes listed in Central Port Coquitlam and condos and townhomes made up 88.5%; of the 19 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Central Port Coquitlam than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 22 in June to 18 in October 2026 (−18.2%); condos and townhomes rose from 134 in June to 139 in October 2026 (+3.7%).

faq.q: What did condos in Central Port Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 152 condos sold in Central Port Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $572,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Central Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
